plainText:
Masaki Terasoma (Japanese: てらそままさき Terasoma Masaki) is a Japanese voice actor for . He is often credited under the name Masanori Jisen. Apart from being a voice actor, he is also a TV actor specially for the role of . He was born on May 8, 1962 in , .

==Biography==
Terasoma started out his work in by voicing . He later provided his voice for Drayden. However, his most prominent role was Looker in and .
